The Call for Papers for the 2027 IPSA World Congress is Now Open!

The Call for Papers is now open for the 29th IPSA World Congress of Political Science at Luiss Guido Carli in Rome, Italy, from 24-28 July 2027 . The #IPSA2027 World Congress will have a diverse program under the theme Uncertain Democracies: Rethinking Governance in a Changing Global System .
